fields.heading: Please verify your email address
fields.body:
Hello {first_name},

Thank you for signing up to Abundance. Please click the button below to verify your email address and activate your account.

If you did not sign up to Abundance, please contact us immediately at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666.
